description:
Parity helps self-directed investors model and compare illustrative defined-outcome options strategies using current market data.

Choose a security, time horizon, and desired outcome parameters. Parity identifies an available expiration and options structure, then explains the estimated cost, downside protection, upside tradeoff, dividends, and liquidity in plain language.

Parity provides educational analysis only. It does not provide personalized investment advice, choose investments for users, connect brokerage accounts, or execute transactions. Results are illustrative and depend on market prices available when generated.

defaultPrompt: Model a 12-month defined floor for 100 shares of SPY with a 5% maximum-loss target.
Compare illustrative defined-floor and buffered-growth outcomes for 100 shares of QQQ over 18 months.
Model an illustrative covered call for 100 shares of TSLA and explain the income and upside tradeoff.
